publish_run_usage_progress awaits one RecordOrchestrationEvent per counted round on the loop's critical path. Each call also runs authorize_run_owner, a DB lookup (orchestration_grpc.rs:4192). Move it to a spawned best-effort publish if latency shows up.
Each increment is priced under the model of the round that reported it. A dropped or reordered progress event moves tokens into the next event's price. The final frame is exact.
Progress totals are per invocation (per segment). A continuation's meter restarts at zero, as RunAgentResponse.usage does.
A progress event published before the gateway's tail subscribes is not replayed, because the live tail has no cursor. The final frame carries the exact total.
Each progress event also occupies the per-run replay ring, so a long Do run can evict older step events for a reconnecting client.
